# SiUSDArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SiUSDArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SiUSDArk

Ark contract for managing USDC deposits into InfiniFi's siUSD vault

This Ark uses the InfiniFiGateway to handle conversions: USDC → siUSD
Flow on deposit (board):
1. Receive USDC from Fleet
2. Use Gateway.mintAndStake() to convert USDC → iUSD → siUSD in one call
Flow on withdrawal (disembark):
1. Use Gateway.unstake() to convert siUSD → iUSD
2. Use Gateway.redeem() to convert iUSD → USDC
3. Return USDC to Fleet


## State Variables
### gateway
The InfiniFi Gateway contract for interacting with the protocol


```solidity
IInfiniFiGateway public immutable gateway
```


### siUSD
The siUSD (staked iUSD) ERC4626 vault contract


```solidity
IERC4626 public immutable siUSD
```

### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark, denominated in USDC

Uses InfiniFi's 1:1 peg mechanism (USDC ↔ iUSD)

Decimal conversion: iUSD (18 decimals) → USDC (6 decimals)

Rounding: Conservative rounding towards zero


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of USDC-equivalent assets|


### _convertIUSDtoUSDC

Converts iUSD amount (18 decimals) to USDC equivalent (6 decimals)

Uses InfiniFi's 1:1 peg mechanism with decimal adjustment

This rounds towards zero, which is the conservative and standard approach


```solidity
function _convertIUSDtoUSDC(uint256 iUSDAmount) internal pure returns (uint256 usdcAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`iUSDAmount`|`uint256`|The iUSD amount in 18 decimals|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usdcAmount`|`uint256`|The equivalent USDC amount in 6 decimals|


### _convertUSDCtoIUSD

Converts USDC amount (6 decimals) to iUSD equivalent (18 decimals)

Uses InfiniFi's 1:1 peg mechanism with decimal adjustment

Internal function for harvesting rewards

siUSD automatically compounds rewards, no manual harvest needed


```solidity

    internal
```
